summary: Verified Module 04 conceptual requirements: AuthN vs AuthZ distinction, token revocation patterns (denylist/short TTL), and public redirect reachability.
evidence: Student accurately distinguished Authentication (identity verification) from Authorization (permission and tenant scoping).
Student explained production token revocation via Redis-backed JTI denylists with TTL and short-lived access token + refresh token rotations.
Student articulated why redirect endpoints must remain unauthenticated for zero-friction web navigation.
